hooks.command: command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 && uv tool install --quiet --python 3.12 "${MEMBRAIN_PACKAGE:-membrain-ai[embedded,semantic] @ https://github.com/chriswu727/membrain/archive/f51c78015fd1336f1cded8415f1774244bd9b4fe.zip}" >/dev/null 2>&1; uvx --offline --python 3.12 --from membrain-ai membrain plugin start >/dev/null 2>&1; true
command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 && uvx --offline --python 3.12 --from membrain-ai membrain plugin hook session-start --host codex 2>/dev/null; true
command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 && uvx --offline --python 3.12 --from membrain-ai membrain plugin hook user-prompt --host codex 2>/dev/null; true
command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 && uvx --offline --python 3.12 --from membrain-ai membrain plugin hook stop --host codex 2>/dev/null; true
